entries.proposition: In cultured cortical neurons the covalent Cdk7 inhibitor lowers phosphorylation of RNA polymerase II CTD serines 2, 5 and 7 over a five-point concentration series; 10 nM does nothing, 50 nM already lowers each by roughly two thirds, 500 and 1000 nM are comparable.
entries.snippet: we probed phosphorylation levels of residues Ser 2, Ser 5 and Ser 7 on RNAPII CTD after 4-h incubation of THZ1 at final concentrations of 10, 50, 250, 500 and 1000 nM
entries.anchor: Results / Irreversible Inhibition of Neuronal Cdk7 by THZ1

entries.proposition: The text names 500 and 1000 nM as the concentrations of greatest effect; the bar chart shows the main step between 10 and 50 nM with a plateau from 250 nM, so the printed sentence understates the lower points.
entries.snippet: Fig 2B (publisher JPEG): p-Ser2 about 100 (10 nM), 33 (50 nM), 26 (250), 20 (500), 16 (1000); p-Ser5 and p-Ser7 similar; stars on every bar from 50 nM

entries.proposition: Inhibition after a 4 h exposure does not recover for 8 h after washout in cultured neurons, as expected for a covalent binder.
entries.snippet: The WB results show that the phosphorylation levels did not recover at least 8 h after the washout of THZ1 by conditioned media from sister cultures
entries.anchor: Results / Irreversible Inhibition of Neuronal Cdk7 by THZ1

entries.proposition: Activity blockade by TTX (2 micromolar, 2 h) lowers Npas4, c-Fos, Nr4a1, Egr1 and Arc mRNAs and RNAPII CTD phosphorylation. The text says THZ1 'similarly' lowers CTD phosphorylation and these IEGs in the absence of any stimulus. It does NOT say THZ1 lowers them further: compared by panel at 2 h (Fig 3C TTX versus Fig 3D THZ1, 500 nM), THZ1 is lower for Nr4a1 (about 0.18 versus 0.47), Egr1 (about 0.16 versus 0.43) and c-Fos (about 0.23 versus 0.28), similar for Npas4 (about 0.45 versus 0.38), and higher (less reduced) for Arc (about 0.77 versus 0.36); Homer1a and c-Jun are about equal (0.68 and 0.79 in both). Values read off the bars by eye (inference).
entries.snippet: Similarly, in the presence of THZ1, which induced drastic decrease of phosphorylation levels of Ser 2, Ser 5 and Ser 7 on the RNAPII CTD
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 Activity Is Required to Maintain Gene Expression at Basal Level

entries.proposition: Bicuculline-induced IEG mRNA (up to about 60-fold) and RNAPII CTD phosphorylation are largely prevented by a 4 h THZ1 pre-incubation.
entries.snippet: Bicuculine-induced drastic upregulation of IEG mRNA levels were largely prevented by THZ1 pre-incubation
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 Is Critical for Activity-Driven Expression of the Neuronal IEGs

entries.proposition: Fig 4C: Npas4 about 59-fold and c-Fos about 46-fold over vehicle after bicuculline; with the inhibitor about 8 and 4-fold; every one of seven IEGs significantly lower.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Npas4 ~59 vs ~8; cFos ~46 vs ~4; Arc ~18 vs ~1; Homer1a ~11 vs ~4; c-Jun ~12 vs ~2

entries.proposition: In acute hippocampal slices the inhibitor leaves early LTP (two trains) unchanged but lowers late LTP (four trains) throughout the recording; the authors note the first 1-2 h of late LTP should not need transcription, so the effect is not purely transcriptional.
entries.snippet: This is noteworthy that the first 1–2 h of L-LTP induced by 4xHFS does not require transcription
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 Activity Is Essential to Long-Lasting Synaptic Plasticity

entries.proposition: Fig 5A-B: E-LTP fEPSP slope about 140 percent in both groups (n.s.); L-LTP about 175 percent at 200 min in vehicle against about 130 percent with the inhibitor (p<0.001); n = 6 and 7 slices.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] E-LTP ~140 both, n.s.; L-LTP ~175 (DMSO) vs ~130 (THZ1) at 200 min, ***

entries.proposition: The pre-incubation time before the slice experiment is not stated consistently: 2 h in the Results sentence, 4 h in the Methods and the Figure 5 legend.
entries.snippet: we pre-incubated acute hippocampal slices in the perfusate containing 500 nM THZ1 or equivalent volume of DMSO for 2 h before fEPSP recordings
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 Activity Is Essential to Long-Lasting Synaptic Plasticity

entries.proposition: A single intracerebroventricular dose of 20 micrograms per mouse lowered RNAPII CTD phosphorylation in whole-brain lysate 6 h later; this is a pharmacodynamic readout in brain, not a drug concentration.
entries.snippet: Six hours after injection of 20 μg of THZ1 or equal volume of DMSO through implanted cannula connected via a catheter, we prepared whole brain lysates and probed the phosphorylation levels of RNAPII CTD
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 Activity Is Necessary for the Formation of Long-Term Memory

entries.proposition: Fig 6B: whole-brain RNAPII CTD phosphorylation after the injection is about 62 (Ser2), 66 (Ser5) and 49 (Ser7) percent of vehicle; n = 6.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] p-Ser2 ~62 **; p-Ser5 ~66 *; p-Ser7 ~49 ***, percent of DMSO

entries.proposition: The injected mice show no difference in distance or speed; short-term object and cued-fear memory are intact, long-term (24 h) memory is impaired in both tasks.
entries.snippet: These data suggest that THZ1 does not disrupt learning process or STM as evidenced by the tests 2 h after exposure, but specifically affected LTM, which requires gene transcription.
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 Activity Is Necessary for the Formation of Long-Term Memory

entries.proposition: Cdk7 protein in cortex is low through E14.5, P0 and P7 and rises at P30 and P60 even though mRNA falls, so the target is present at far lower protein level in early development than in the adult.
entries.snippet: However, in contrast to the gradual reduction at mRNA level, Cdk7 protein level significantly increased at adult ages in mice
entries.anchor: Results / Expression of Cdk7 in the Mouse Cortex

entries.proposition: The authors advise caution about neurological side effects of Cdk7 inhibitors in clinical use and propose, as a hypothesis not tested here, that the inhibitor might lower seizure susceptibility as a bromodomain inhibitor did.
entries.snippet: Hypothetically, THZ1 may exert therapeutic effects comparable to Jq1, in terms of decreasing seizure susceptibility.

entries.proposition: No seizure, EEG or susceptibility measurement is reported: behaviour is mobility, object recognition and cued freezing only.
entries.snippet: Therefore caution should be taken in potential clinical trials to avoid risk of neurological side effects.
entries.anchor: Discussion (final paragraph); negative established by Methods and Results as a whole
